sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and kind words. We value our long cooperation with your family foundry and understand the labour cost pressure you describe.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

We would like to offer you the security of a longer term and propose three options for PH-100:
- Option A: EUR 50.60 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.27 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01
- Option C: EUR 50.20 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our long-standing partnership and appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract.
As a family-run foundry, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, but our pricing strictly reflects the necessary adjustments to maintain our quality.
Building on your Option C, we can offer €51.40 per unit for a 24-month term with 30-day payment terms starting 2027-04-01.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving on the price. We also appreciate your answer on the payment terms. Our long partnership with your foundry matters a great deal to us, and we want a contract that gives you security for the coming years.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342). On that basis, we would like to take a step towards you and keep the package you answered:

- Option A: EUR 50.72 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.37 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to hearing from you, and send our warm regards to everyone at the foundry.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We can accept your terms and await your order.

We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
